description: Replication Data for: Optimal Heat Storage Sizing for District Heating Networks to Maximize Electricity Revenue from Combined Heat and Power Units is a data set deposited in KU Leuven RDR by its authors Martin Sollich (Associatie KU Leuven). A dataset containing the district heating network structure and the (aggregated) time series used in the case study of the paper "Optimal Heat Storage Sizing for District Heating Networks to Maximize Electricity Revenue from Combined Heat and Power Units". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: Excel, TXT. Size stated: 11145589. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
